stem: Which question would BEST help determine whether the change in eye span in stalk-eyed flies was influenced by natural selection?

options.label: A
options.text: Is the eye span of male stalk-eyed flies similar to that of female flies?

options.label: B
options.text: What is the relationship between the body length and eye span of stalk-eyed flies?

options.label: C
options.text: How does the eye span of stalk-eyed flies compare from one generation to the next?

options.label: D
options.text: Do fossilized stalk-eyed flies have a shorter body length than living flies?

visual_elements: Figure with two stalk-eyed flies: one fossilized in Baltic amber with smaller eye span and body length labeled, and one living with larger eye span and body length labeled
